name: Dolyna-Uzhhorod-State Border Gas Pipeline (second string)

values.RouteNotes: No published GIS or map trace found. Candidate for a human routes-repo PR from the Dolyna to Uzhhorod corridor.

researcher_notes: A table of main gas transmission objects on the Ukrainian gas transmission operator's site (archived June 2022) lists 'Dolina-Uzhgorod-Gosgranitsa (II string)', 1400 mm, 5.4 MPa, 182 km, one string, Ukraine. The table shows only the second string. No first-string entry was found. Not a match to existing rows: P0777 and P1480 (Kyiv to Western Border) are 1020 and 1220 mm, P0779 ends at Dolyna and is 1420 mm, P0768 and P0774 are whole-system rows that run 4,000+ km. P1462 and P1463 (68 and 42 km, 1400 mm) feed into Dolyna and sit upstream, so this is a distinct 182 km leg. Status operating is inferred from the table listing it as a current object; no dated statement of operation was found. Owner and operator are not stated in the table, so they are left blank. Only one source was found and a search in Ukrainian turned up no second source, so confidence is medium. Pressure of 5.4 MPa is odd next to the 7.4 MPa feeders and is worth a check. Whether the first string exists was not found.
